summary: API: Jira intake loop, approvals resume, cancel, executor wiring
epic_summary: WS-C Control API (FastAPI, sessions, runs, SSE events, approvals)
description:
Due 2026-11-06. Builds on ANVIL-11.

## Do

* Background task every 60 s: `jira_intake_candidates()` (devin, anvil.tools.jira) -> create session + run (trigger `jira:<key>`, mode autonomous, merge_policy from label `anvil-merge-agent` else human, repo + base branch from the ticket's "Code base:" line) -> `jira_transition(key, "In Progress")`. Off switch via env.
* `POST /api/approvals/{id}` resumes the run through the executor; `POST /api/runs/{id}/cancel` -> status `cancelled` (contract updated in PR #6).
* Plug in claude's executor (ANVIL-18) behind the `RunExecutor` interface.

## Acceptance

Labelling RTEMS-1 `anvil` starts a run within 60 s, visible in the UI; approve/reject and cancel work end to end.
